task: Build mobile web weight-painting tool wired into the repo pipeline
resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — build a MOBILE-FIRST web weight-painting tool, owner-directed 2026-10-09. CONTEXT: The owner works on Android and refuses to go to a desktop Blender. Automated weight repair on STICKUP_repaired.glb failed 6x (PR #50) — the shoulders need a human eye. He wants the tool IN his stack: a link he opens on his phone, wired into his repos/pipelines, simple and accessible. YOUR JOB: build a single-page web app (Three.js) that: (1) loads a GLB from a URL (default: STICKUP_repaired.glb from the repo); (2) lists bones — tapping a bone selects it for painting; (3) shows current skin weights as heat colors on the mesh; (4) touch brush paints weights with adjustable radius + strength, auto-normalizes across the 4 joint influences; (5) LIVE POSE TEST: a slider raises the arm 0-90deg so he sees the deformation change as he paints — this is the core loop; (6) exports the GLB with modified weights (download button) + a one-tap 'send back to pipeline' path (clear instructions: where the file goes, what happens next — the probe_shoulders.py verification + PR flow); (7) big touch targets, works on a phone screen, no desktop assumptions. SCOPE DISCIPLINE: this is a focused shoulder-weight tool, not a Blender replacement — nail the paint -> pose-test -> export loop. DELIVERY: build as a web artifact (he asked for a link) AND commit the source into the repo (tools/weight-paint-pwa/) so it's part of the pipeline, not a toy — wire it to load models from the repo's assets/models/. RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint every 15 min; test the app yourself (load the real STICKUP_repaired.glb, paint a stroke, move the pose slider, export and verify the GLB still loads with modified weights) before calling it done; no placeholder UI; mobile-first. Report: the artifact link, the repo path, and your self-test results (load/paint/pose/export verified).
notes: DONE 2026-10-09. App self-tested (load/paint/pose/export). Repo: tools/weight-paint-pwa/ via PR #51 (merged). Web artifact: stick-up-weight-paint (built).
